title: Clean cycle: first frame equals last frame
description: For models with first and last frame: the start and end image are the same pose image, the action ends in exactly the starting pose.

body.subject: This armoured warrior, exactly as in [start_image]: {{design_lock}}.
body.action: {{cycle_action}}, ending in exactly the starting pose.
body.camera: Locked-off orthographic {{view}} view, no camera movement, no zoom, no cuts.
body.style: Flat even studio light, plain light-grey backdrop.
body.constraints: Full body in frame, feet on the floor line, exactly two arms and two legs, the final frame identical to [end_image].

design_lock.default: dark bronze plate armour, gold lion-head pauldrons, crimson cloth skirt with a gold meander hem, black undersuit
design_lock.description: what must stay unchanged: the design in words

cycle_action.default: He walks in place through one full gait cycle

bytedance/seedance*.note: names references in prose; roles are start_image / end_image / video references

higgsfield/*.note: Higgsfield media roles: start_image, end_image, image_references, video_references

heygen/*.note: audio is always on and not controllable; only a first frame is taken

gates.description: largest per-joint difference between the first and last frame
